statBlock.name: Poltergeist
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead, chaotic neutral
statBlock.description: A spirit that moves objects around its haunts. Some absent-minded ghosts retrace old routines, while others use the things they move to play tricks or menace the living.

sections.Damage resistances: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal Movement. It treats creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain when passing through them. The poltergeist takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Object Slam attack and use Telekinetic Thrust.
Object Slam. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Telekinetic Thrust. Choose one creature the poltergeist can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d6 + 2) force damage and is pushed straight away from the poltergeist by up to 30 ft.
sections.Bonus actions: Vanish. Become Invisible or end that condition on itself.

statBlock.name: Scarecrow
statBlock.description: A spirit of vengeance bound to a patchwork frame. It might obey its maker or defend a place, household, or community.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Fearsome Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage and leaves the target Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
Terrifying Glare. One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn and Paralyzed while Frightened by this glare.

statBlock.name: Skeleton
statBlock.description: An animated pile of bones that can fight with a blade or bow. It understands commands even though it cannot speak.

sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Yuan-ti Abomination
statBlock.description: A large serpent-bodied yuan-ti that can tighten its coils around foes or take the shape of a large snake.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Constrict. One Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 28 (7d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until that grapple ends. On a success, it takes half damage.
Poison Spray (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of the yuan-ti's next turn. A creature Poisoned this way is also Blinded for the duration of that condition. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Large snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 15). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.

statBlock.name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)
statBlock.speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft. in snake form only
statBlock.description: A snake-headed yuan-ti that can spit poison at range in its true form.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Stealth increases to +6 in snake form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination using Bite or Poison Ray, subject to their form restrictions. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Poison Ray (yuan-ti form only). Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 13). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.
